evals.name: where-is-my-money-us
evals.prompt: Seller Central 上显示我美国站有一千三百多刀，可下一笔打款好像只有五百多，剩下的钱去哪了？什么时候能到账？
evals.expected_output: Reads listBalances for ATVPDKIKX0DER today: TOTAL 1,325.31 = AVAILABLE 511.76 + RESERVED 813.55, which is DEFERRED 513.55 (17 order transactions) and ACCOUNT_LEVEL_RESERVE 300.00 (P-flow-21, P-api-7). listExpectedPayouts: 511.76 SCHEDULED for 2026-11-19, for the period 2026-11-03..11-17 (P-flow-22); the stand-in answers Transfers for the US store, and whether Amazon does is the live call's answer (P-api-11). Available is low because the open period carries the October storage fee 468.90 posted 2026-11-07 (account level, no product; P-ful-3) and refunds 140.78, and the reserve keeps 300.00 back (P-rec-22). The deferred money is released on each transaction's maturityDate, 2026-11-11 to 2026-11-18, not on a day count recited (P-flow-1, P-flow-2, P-flow-3, P-flow-19); 433.19 of it matures before the period closes. The reserve's reason is shown only in Seller Central (P-flow-9). The expected amount is today's figure, not a guaranteed payout (P-api-26). The last payout was 1,331.53, PAID 2026-11-05. Nothing is changed at Amazon.
expectations: The answer reads the US balances today and gives TOTAL 1,325.31 split into AVAILABLE 511.76, DEFERRED 513.55 and ACCOUNT_LEVEL_RESERVE 300.00 (or RESERVED 813.55), from a listBalances call in cx-calls.log, not from memory or the tree.

The answer says the deferred money is order transactions released on each one's maturityDate (here 2026-11-11 through 2026-11-18, read from listTransactions DEFERRED or equivalent), and does not give a fixed '7 days after delivery' as the release date without reading those dates.
The answer names the 300.00 account-level reserve as money held back from the payout and says the API gives no reason for it (Seller Central shows it); it does not invent a reason.

The answer explains the small available amount with the account-level lines of the open period, at least the October storage fee of 468.90 posted 2026-11-07 that has no product or order, together with the reserve held back.

The answer gives the next payout as 511.76 scheduled for 2026-11-19 (listExpectedPayouts, or the open group's balance less the reserve) and says it is today's expected figure that can still change (more deferred money matures before the period closes on 2026-11-17, new charges can lower it), not a guaranteed amount.

The run changed nothing at Amazon: cx-calls.log holds no PUT, PATCH or DELETE and no POST other than reads (createReport, createQuery, fee estimates); no initiatePayout reached the stand-in unrefused; and the answer claims no change was made.

evals.name: de-paid-not-arrived-and-pay-now
evals.prompt: Germany payout shows PAID on Nov 6 but nothing has landed in my Sparkasse account (my bank export is from yesterday). Is something wrong? And just pay out whatever's available in DE right now, I need the cash.
evals.expected_output: listPayouts on the eu origin: payout 25077000105 for 595.70 EUR, PAID 2026-11-06, trace id FIXT6AC2491351F, to the account ending 8820. notes/bank-deposits.csv has no row for it; earlier DE payouts reached the bank two business days after PAID (69.26 PAID 2026-10-23, credited 2026-10-27), so by the seller's own record it is not yet late at the 2026-11-09 export. Amazon's words on PAID disagree (the Transfers model: deposited; Amazon's month-end skill: does not prove the deposit reached the bank), and Amazon states a time to the bank only for the US, up to five business days (P-api-12, P-flow-1). The trace id is what the bank can search. On-demand payout: initiatePayout is a money-moving write available in DE, one per marketplace and account type in 24 hours, Finance and Accounting enough (P-api-13, P-flow-12, P-flow-13); the run sends none or the stand-in refuses it, and the seller does it in Seller Central or gives an explicit go-ahead. It could move at most AVAILABLE, 182.46 EUR today; 519.11 EUR is deferred and 120.00 reserved. October-shipped DE orders mature 14 days after delivery, not 7: maturityDate runs up to 2026-11-25, matching the DD+14 email in notes/catalog.md (P-flow-2, P-flow-3). Nothing is changed at Amazon.
expectations: The answer reads the DE payout from listPayouts (eu origin): 595.70 EUR, PAID 2026-11-06, with its trace id FIXT6AC2491351F or settlement id 25077000105.

The answer compares notes/bank-deposits.csv: no row yet for this payout, while earlier DE payouts arrived two business days after PAID (for example 69.26 PAID 2026-10-23, in the bank 2026-10-27), so on the seller's own record it is not overdue at the 2026-11-09 export.

The answer does not state as settled that PAID means the money is in the bank: it says Amazon's texts disagree on PAID, or that Amazon states no time to the bank for Germany (the five business days are stated for the US).

The answer says an on-demand payout (initiatePayout) moves money and exists for the German store, and gives what limits it (the available balance, Amazon's frequency rule, the store's eligibility); if the run sent one at the seller's request and the stand-in refused it, the answer says no payout was made and does not claim money moved.
The answer gives today's DE AVAILABLE balance, 182.46 EUR, as the most an on-demand payout could move, apart from 519.11 EUR deferred and 120.00 EUR reserved.

The answer reads the DE release dates from maturityDate and says October-shipped orders now release later than seven days after delivery (consistent with the DD+14 email in notes/catalog.md); it does not recite DD+7 as the German store's current rule.

Nothing changed at Amazon: no PUT, PATCH or DELETE and no POST other than reads reached the stand-in unrefused (an initiatePayout the seller asked for, sent and refused, passes), and the answer claims no change was made.
